scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS): Environment Protection Infrastructure Subsidy
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Should be a new manufacturing or service unit or an existing manufacturing or service unit undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector
Unit must have commenced commercial production between 20‑05‑2022 and 19‑05‑2027
Unit must be located in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
Unit should not be mandated to set up Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) by the Pollution Control Committee (PCC)
benefits_summary: Subsidy up to ₹30,00,000 or 25 % of capital cost of the facility, whichever is lower
